confirmClear: Clear the mat? Press again to put everything back in the tray.
hintOpenStart: Bring anything to a hoop. Something that belongs in both goes where they cross.
hintOpenLens: Is there anything that belongs in both? It goes where the hoops cross.
hintOpenBoth: Read one hoop out loud. What is the same about everything inside it?
hintChoose: The class will see this rule. Choose it before they arrive, or tap Surprise me.
hintSecret: The rules are set and nobody has seen them — not even you.
hintGuessStart: Bring one thing to a hoop. The hoop keeps it or lets it go. Say nothing.
hintGuessOut: The hoop let that one go. What a hoop will not keep is half the answer.
hintGuessRead: Read what each hoop has kept, then ask what its rule might be.
hintTrayEmpty: Everything has been sorted. Read the two sets, then bring more things.
hintCarry: Choose a hoop with the arrow keys, then press Enter.
hintRuleChanged: The rules changed. Some things have come back out.
hintChildTurn: Hand the board to a child. They choose the rules; the class works them out.
refuseNoRule: Set a rule for at least one hoop first.
refuseSameRule: The other hoop already has that rule. Choose a different one.
refuseNoPair: Nothing could belong to both hoops. Choose a different rule.
famSyll: How many beats in the word?
famInitial: What sound does the word start with?
famSizeBand: How big is the real thing?
